root.label: Trump and six AI companies sign self-regulation accord

events.label: Trump and six AI companies sign self-regulation accord

slots.name: companies involved
slots.sentence: The leaders of six major technology companies signed a joint commitment in Washington on Sept. 29 meant to self-regulate the safe development of artificial intelligence.

slots.name: control layers
slots.sentence: Executives from Google, Meta, OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia and SpaceX established four layers of “controls and audits” that their companies will implement, including “robust” internal controls and external evaluations.

slots.name: binding status
slots.sentence: While the accord is not federally binding, it does hold some weight with the government in the form of the Federal Trade Commission, which has the ability to oversee voluntary commitments and regulate unfair and deceptive trade practices.

slots.name: signing date
slots.sentence: The leaders met with Trump in Washington on Sept. 29 before signing the accord.
